attribution: Measurements belong to the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations. Transcription and conditional comparison are laboratory work.
combinationPolicy: Compare separately. No combined likelihood or significance is constructed; inter-channel and inter-experiment correlations have not been supplied.
scope: Reported total-error bands are experimental uncertainty summaries. Certified numerical enclosures at fixed one-loop inputs are not theory uncertainty bands or model exclusion tests.

measurements.selectionNote: Uses the published Run 1 + Run 2 combination. The Run 2-only result is 125.04 +/- 0.12 GeV.
